title: slugify should drop accents instead of splitting words
description: `slugify` in `src/slug.js` treats accented letters as separators, so `Crème Brûlée` becomes `cr-me-br-l-e`. Accented Latin letters should lose their accents instead: `Crème Brûlée` should become `creme-brulee` and `São Paulo` should become `sao-paulo`. Text that is already written with combining accents should give the same slug as text written with precomposed letters. Nothing else about slugs changes.
acceptance_criteria: a word written with combining accent marks gives the same slug as the precomposed spelling
existing slugs are unchanged and `npm test` passes
